annotations.title: Send feedback or a bug report to the Fermi team

api_key.description: Optional Fermi API key. If given, the account id is attached so the team can look into it.
api_key.title: Api Key

error_text.description: The error code and message the tool returned, if any. Remove any personal data or private context it quotes.
error_text.title: Error Text

estimate_id.description: The estimate_id the report is about, if an estimate was involved.
estimate_id.title: Estimate Id

expected.description: What you expected to happen instead.
expected.title: Expected

feedback_type.description: What kind of report this is. bug: a tool errored or broke. wrong_result: it ran but the estimate looks wrong. unmet_use_case: the user needed something no tool does. feature_request: a missing option or parameter. confusing: a description, output or error was hard to understand. praise: something worked well. other: anything else (the default).
feedback_type.title: Feedback Type

impact.description: How much it cost the user. blocked: could not finish. workaround: finished another way. minor: an annoyance. none: no cost, for example praise.
impact.title: Impact

message.description: The report, in your own words, 10 to 5,000 characters. Say what you tried, what happened and what you expected. Leave out names, companies, the user's numbers or private context, and the conversation itself: write "a market-size question", not the question's details.
message.title: Message

sender_email.description: Optional. The user's email address, only if they want a reply and gave it to you. Do not invent one. No copy is sent to it.
sender_email.title: Sender Email

sender_name.description: The user's name. Optional; only with sender_email.
sender_name.title: Sender Name

suggestion.description: What would have helped: a fix, a new feature or clearer wording.
suggestion.title: Suggestion

tool_name.description: The Fermi tool the report is about, for example estimate_quantity_or_probability.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

user_goal.description: What the user was trying to do, as a general task in a few words, for example "forecast a market size". No names, company names or figures.
user_goal.title: User Goal

what_happened.description: What actually happened, in general terms, without the user's numbers.
what_happened.title: What Happened

name: send_feedback

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

message.description: Confirmation text, including whether the team can reply.

title: Send feedback or a bug report to the Fermi team
